g.text: What does each cue-visible team lose when the cue is removed at evaluation?

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: One dot represents one cue-visible team's score, where one team is one pair of defenders A and B trained corresponding to one seed. The black line is the mean of the teams that have a value; a team without one is not drawn. A control plays the same trained

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: team again with one of B's inputs changed; nothing is retrained. A dot is the team's normal value minus its value under the control. Differences between shares are in percentage points (pp). B's response rate is pooled separately in the normal evaluation and in

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: the control, each over its own interruptions; the figure's CSV holds the two rates in the rows marked normal and control. Normal minus control, team reward per episode: over all episodes - denominator: number of episodes | Normal minus control, B's infected

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: server-intervals per intrusion episode: over intrusion episodes - denominator: number of intrusion episodes | Normal minus control, A interrupted the attacked pair's server after the intrusion: over intrusion episodes - denominator: intrusion episodes | Normal

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: minus control, B responded to A's interruption: over A's interruptions of the attacked pair's server that B had a free choice to answer in time - denominator: none, a difference of two pooled rates, each over its own interruptions
